parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The type of the tag. Valid values:

*   Normal
*   System

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-asset-tags --key key1 --category Normal --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListDataAssetTags --region cn-hangzhou --Category Normal --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Key key1
